params.name: path
params.description: The file path to blame, relative to the repository root.

params.name: ref
params.description: The git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to blame at. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

items.docs:
Returns blame information for a file at a given repository path and optional git ref.

The response is split into two parts:
- `ranges`: contiguous, non-overlapping line ranges, each attributed to a single commit. Ordered by `startLine`.
- `commits`: commit metadata (hash, date, message, author, optional `previous` pointer for walking back through history) keyed by hash, deduplicated across ranges.

Whole-file renames are followed automatically. Cross-file line moves and copies are not.
Returns the file tree for a repository at a given revision.

params.name: base
params.description: The base git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to diff from.

params.name: head
params.description: The head git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to diff to.

params.name: path
params.description: Restrict the diff to changes touching this file path. Omit to diff all changes between the two refs.

items.docs: Returns a structured diff between two git refs using a two-dot comparison. See [git-diff](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-diff) for details.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter commits by message content (case-insensitive). Interpreted as a POSIX BRE regex — escape metacharacters for literal matching.

params.name: since
params.description: Return commits after this date. Accepts ISO 8601 or relative formats (e.g. `30 days ago`).

params.name: until
params.description: Return commits before this date. Accepts ISO 8601 or relative formats.

params.name: author
params.description: Filter commits by author name or email (case-insensitive). Interpreted as a POSIX BRE regex — escape metacharacters for literal matching.

params.name: ref
params.description: The git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to list commits from. Defaults to `HEAD`.

params.name: path
params.description: Restrict commits to those that touch this file path.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of commits for a repository.

params.name: ref
params.description: The git ref (commit SHA, branch, or tag).

items.docs: Returns details for a single commit, including parent commit SHAs.

params.name: ref
params.description: The git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to list authors from. Defaults to `HEAD`.

params.name: path
params.description: Restrict authors to those who touched this file path.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of unique authors who committed in a repository, sorted by commit count descending. Optionally scoped to a file path.
